fn rs_error(stage: *RsStage, location: *RmdLoc, message: *u8) -> unit {
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    (*stage).failed = true;
    rmd_set_error((*stage).context, (*location).source, (*location).offset, message);
}

fn rs_alloc(stage: *RsStage, size: usize, alignment: usize) -> *u8 {
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*u8); }
    if size == 0usize { return null(*u8); }
    var result: *u8 = rmd_try_alloc((*stage).context, size, alignment);
    if result == null(*u8) { (*stage).failed = true; }
    return result;
}

fn rs_put(stage: *RsStage, table: *RmdMap, key: usize, value: *u8) -> unit {
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    if !rmd_try_map_set((*stage).context, table, key, value) { (*stage).failed = true; }
}

fn rs_name(stage: *RsStage) -> *RmdName {
    var bytes: [u8; 32] = uninit;
    var end: usize = 32usize;
    var value: usize = (*stage).next_name;
    (*stage).next_name = value + 1usize;
    while true {
        end = end - 1usize;
        bytes[end] = (value % 10usize) as u8 + 48u8;
        value = value / 10usize;
        if value == 0usize { break; }
    }
    end = end - 1usize; bytes[end] = 36u8;
    var name: *RmdName = rmd_try_intern((*stage).context, &bytes[end], 32usize - end);
    if name == null(*RmdName) { (*stage).failed = true; }
    return name;
}

fn rs_type_node(stage: *RsStage, kind: u32, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdTypeSyntax {
    var node: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdTypeSyntax), alignof(RmdTypeSyntax)) as *RmdTypeSyntax;
    if node != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { (*node).kind = kind; (*node).loc = *location; }
    return node;
}

fn rs_expr_node(stage: *RsStage, kind: u32, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdExpr {
    var node: *RmdExpr = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdExpr), alignof(RmdExpr)) as *RmdExpr;
    if node != null(*RmdExpr) { (*node).kind = kind; (*node).loc = *location; }
    return node;
}

fn rs_stmt_node(stage: *RsStage, kind: u32, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdStmt {
    var node: *RmdStmt = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdStmt), alignof(RmdStmt)) as *RmdStmt;
    if node != null(*RmdStmt) { (*node).kind = kind; (*node).loc = *location; }
    return node;
}

fn rs_named(stage: *RsStage, name: *RmdName, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdExpr {
    var node: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_NAME, location);
    if node != null(*RmdExpr) { (*node).name = name; }
    return node;
}

fn rs_unary(stage: *RsStage, op: u32, operand: *RmdExpr, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdExpr {
    var node: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_UNARY, location);
    if node != null(*RmdExpr) { (*node).op = op; (*node).left = operand; }
    return node;
}

fn rs_append(list: *RsStatements, statement: *RmdStmt) -> unit {
    if statement == null(*RmdStmt) { return; }
    if (*list).first == null(*RmdStmt) { (*list).first = statement; }
    else { (*(*list).last).next = statement; }
    (*list).last = statement;
}

fn rs_block(stage: *RsStage, list: *RsStatements, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdStmt {
    var node: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_BLOCK, location);
    if node != null(*RmdStmt) { (*node).body = (*list).first; }
    return node;
}

fn rs_init(stage: *RsStage, context: *RmdContext) -> unit {
    var bytes: *u8 = stage as *u8;
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    while index < sizeof(RsStage) { bytes[index] = 0u8; index = index + 1usize; }
    (*stage).context = context;
    (*stage).next_name = 1usize;
}
